name: Backoffice: Manager to Waiter role switch - sidebar and permissions update
description: Log in as manager in backoffice, verify full sidebar, log out, log in as waiter. Waiter should either be denied access or see a minimal sidebar.

planSteps.description: Fill in email 'amanuel@fufut.coffee' and password 'selam@336', then click the Sign In or Login button
Verify successful login: URL contains '/backoffice/app/' and the sidebar shows multiple navigation sections (Staff, Inventory, Reports, etc.) appropriate for a manager
Verify the top-right user chip or sidebar shows the manager's name 'Amanuel'
Click the 'Sign Out' button in the sidebar footer
Verify the user is redirected to /backoffice/login
Now fill in email 'yonas@fufut.coffee' and password 'selam@336' (waiter account), then click Sign In

Either (a) the login is rejected with an error because waiters cannot access the backoffice, OR (b) if accepted, the sidebar shows ONLY waiter-permitted items - NOT Staff management, Inventory, or other manager-only sections. The user chip must NOT show 'Amanuel'.
If logged in as waiter, try to navigate the browser URL directly to /backoffice/app/staff
Verify the app redirects to the waiter's default view or back to login, NOT showing staff management content
Verify the user is back at /backoffice/login with no residual session data
